Summaries.eng: Wangyou, Master of Hanshui Temple died mysteriously and when the news about a golden coffin spreads throughout the world, it triggered disputes between the World of Martial arts. Join a group of youths, Lei Wujie, Xiao Se, Tang Lian, Sikong Qianluo, Heavenly Maiden Rui in their adventure as the mystery of the golden coffin unravels.

Aliases: Shao Nian Ge Xing Feng Hua Xue Yue

Summaries.zho: 寒水寺忘忧大师坐化后，一口神秘的黄金棺材入世，掀起江湖纷争。各方势力针锋相对，雷无桀、萧瑟、唐莲、司空千落、天女蕊等相继卷入争端，一场围绕黄金棺材的故事即将上演。策马江湖梦，倚剑踏歌行。黄金棺材的秘密，逐渐浮现……

Titles.eng: First Time In The Martial Arts World
Killing Intention On A Snowy Night
Master Of Lonely Sword In Muliang
An Old Friend In The Kingdom of Khotan
The Chess Game Of The World
Make A Buddhist Out Of Evilness

Titles.zho: 少年歌行 风花雪月篇

Summaries.eng:
Second season of Shaonian Ge Xing.
Don't be afraid of failure. Don't waste your youth. After Xiao Se and Lei Wujie came to Snow and Moon City, Sikong Changfeng forcibly took Xiao Se as his apprentice. Lei Wujie and Li Hanyi recognized each other. As Xiao Se entered Snow and Moon City, other princes of Tianqi were eager to seek allies. A battle between princes slowly started at the hero banquet in Lei Jia Bao.
Summaries.zho: 不惧失败，不枉少年。萧瑟、雷无桀来到雪月城后，司空长风强行收萧瑟为徒，雷无桀与李寒衣姐弟相认。随着萧瑟进入雪月城，天启的其他王子蠢蠢欲动、纷纷寻求盟友，一场皇子间的争斗在雷家堡的英雄宴上徐徐展开。

Titles.eng: An Old Friend is Probably Here
Point Your Sword Toward The Cloud
The Sword Shine Brightly Amidst The Snow
Youths Making a Name for Themselves
Sword Casket's Shadow in The Snow
Heroes Go On a Journey Again
The Martial Arts World is Where Your Heart is
Never Stop Missing You at Night
Hidden Dragon Hides in The Cold Mountains
Magnanimity That Flows Like a Hundred Rivers
The Unfulfilled Wish of This Lifetime

Titles.zho: 少年歌行 海外仙山篇

Summaries.zho: 行到水穷处，坐看云起时。雷家堡一战后，雷家家主战死，剑仙陨落，萧瑟强行使用内力导致自身生命垂危。为挽救萧瑟，众人踏向神秘的海外仙山，只为寻找那传说之中的仙人。而与此同时的朝堂与江湖之争，仍在继续。

Titles.zho: 少年歌行 血染天启篇

Summaries.zho: 拜别仙山后，莫衣与百里东君两大绝世高手退隐。萧瑟隐脉已然恢复，重回逍遥天境，雷无桀等人也相继得到仙人馈赠，实力也有不同地提升。众人决心赶赴天启城，江湖一别，朝堂再见。永安王萧瑟、白王萧崇、赤王萧羽三大势力汇聚一堂，夺嫡之争正式上演，谁又将登上那天启乘龙之位。
